body:
Automated bridge job `RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-3154` (pool: codex-personal), single commit on base `6b1ad2fe8`.

**Tests:** no test command

**Tier-1 (CODEOWNERS) paths, async post-merge review:** test/verse-api-mount-310.test.ts

<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-3154

Status: LOCAL UPDATE PREPARED; existing PR not updated or enqueued.

Existing PR: https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/pull/3154
Head branch: masonwyatt23/phantom:codex-bridge/RQ-APPTRUTH-6-SOURCEOFTRUTHR2
Original head: 304ef27e329181566d233dfa968651c5e2a362f3
Fetched master / unchanged local HEAD: 6b1ad2fe888d66434e586fb77881c9f7931a0416

## Result

Applied the PR's binary diff relative to its last master merge parent
2668a7b1b927ea3d5e99ae0edb1190ed1217d0ee onto current master with
`git apply --3way`. Resolved all 30 conflicts. Retained the current app
update/steer commands, resource freshness and fraction parsing, provider marks,
API query validation, current API routes, mobile screens, and current tests.
Restored the remaining Forum CLI/service/MCP/mobile surface and Mission's
activity, timeline, plan log, forum projection and file-backed invalidations.
The service reuses the existing read-only Forum projection instead of carrying
a second implementation. Integrated `app state` into the existing dispatcher
rather than retaining the source patch's unreachable duplicate `case 'app'`.
Mission refresh rereads its sources within the former two-second cache window;
concurrent requests still share one read. Regression coverage includes this
refresh, the app alias, live stream teardown and the restored feature suites.

Updated exact API/tool inventories and schema snapshots for the restored Forum
and five intent tools already on master. Historical MCP ceilings remain
24,205 and 9,884 bytes. Separate, measured caps cover the new Forum tool
(818 bytes) and already-landed intent operations (1,775 bytes), with no growth
headroom. Retained the inherited screenshot; no new screenshot was captured.

The task's final rule says not to commit, push, tag or publish and requires
all edits to remain uncommitted. Therefore no commit, remote branch update,
new PR, publish.sh invocation or merge-queue request was made. Do not publish
this work as a new PR: it belongs only to the existing branch above.

## Commands and checks

All test commands below used `HOME=$(mktemp -d)`. Logs and the original patch
are under `/tmp/rq-rebase-3154/`; installation/discovery logs also use the
`/tmp/rq-rebase-3154-*` prefix. Read-only rg/sed/diff/git inspections were used
throughout conflict resolution.

- `node --version`: v22.22.3.
- `npm install -g @ashlr/phantom`: failed EPERM under the configured global
  prefix. `npm install -g --prefix /tmp/rq-rebase-3154-phantom-cli @ashlr/phantom`:
  passed. No live dispatcher or operator installation was changed.
- `phm --version`; `phm docs --agent --json`; `phm help`; `phm mcp list --json`;
  `phm wire status --json`; `phm mcp doctor --json`;
  `phm authority status --json`; `phm authority setup --dry-run --json`: ran.
  Companion probes reported unavailable executables/loopback EPERM; authority
  dry-run reported unmet setup prerequisites. No grants or auth edits were made.
  Repeated agent-docs, MCP-list and wire-status with the /tmp installation;
  wire status exited 1. Optional console launch/editor rewiring was not needed.
- `gh pr view 3154 -R ashlrai/phantom --json number,state,title,url,mergedAt,closedAt,baseRefName,headRefName,headRepositoryOwner,isCrossRepository,mergeStateStatus`:
  failed: host denies reading ~/.config/gh/config.yml. Connected GitHub tools
  confirmed open/unmerged/conflicting and read CI run 41735895230. Merge Gate
  failed because Quick typecheck's authority-closure check failed. Dependency
  Audit passed; Vercel's failure is not required.
- `git fetch origin master`; `git fetch fork codex-bridge/RQ-APPTRUTH-6-SOURCEOFTRUTHR2`:
  passed. `git fetch --deepen=3000 origin master`: failed on a shared
  shallow.lock; left the lock untouched and used the known-base patch.
- `git diff --binary 2668a7b1b927ea3d5e99ae0edb1190ed1217d0ee 304ef27e329181566d233dfa968651c5e2a362f3`;
  `git apply --3way /tmp/rq-rebase-3154/pr.patch`: applied with 30 conflicts,
  subsequently resolved. No merge or rebase commit was created.
- `npm run install:worktree`: passed with pnpm 10.28.2; both dependency-healing
  steps passed. Required because the first typecheck could not find tsgo and
  the first lint could not find ESLint's CLI module.
- `npm run typecheck`: after dependency repair exposed four missing imports
  and one temporary invalid dependency property; corrected. Subsequent backend
  and web typechecks passed. Final post-refresh rerun: passed (backend and web).
- `npm run lint`: first repaired-environment run found 3 no-control-regex
  errors and 273 warnings. Replaced escape-character regex alternatives in
  two existing leader-reply tests with equally strict not-toContain assertions;
  removed one unused import. Their existing three functional failures exposed
  an obsolete fixture without last_tick; supplied a tick ten seconds before
  the fixture's deterministic clock, retaining all numeric expectations.
  Final full lint rerun emitted no diagnostics for ten minutes and was
  stopped with Ctrl-C (exit 130); incomplete, not a pass. Explicit changed-file ESLint passes;
  `npm run lint:realio-lane` and `npm run lint:verse-sync-io` pass, with existing
  real-I/O membership warnings.
- `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs`: run once in the foreground; it
  failed at authority drift (9 passed/1 failed); the protected closure snapshot
  was not regenerated.
- `npm run check:docs`: passed, errors [].
- `npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=2 test/fleet-forum.test.ts test/fleet-forum-sim.test.ts test/fleet-mission-stream.test.ts test/fleet-forum-core.test.ts test/recut-desk-low-old-70-forum.test.ts test/fleet-mission.test.ts test/app-update-status.test.ts`:
  first 45 passed/0 failed. After added regressions and projection reuse,
  45 passed/2 failed due to imports removed while deduplicating the service;
  restored those imports. Final simulation rerun passed 2/0. Final Mission
  refresh regression rerun passed 11/0. Latest per-file feature results are
  47 passed/0 failed across the seven feature files. No application tests were removed/skipped.
- `npm run test:web -- src/web-ui/routes/verse/fleet-forum src/web-ui/routes/verse/fleet-mission src/web-ui/routes/verse/mobile/screens/ForumScreen.test.tsx src/web-ui/routes/verse/mobile/mobile-model.test.ts --maxWorkers=2`:
  initial 29/0; final 30 passed/0 failed in 8 files.
- `node --test --import tsx test/docs-fleet-verbs.test.ts`: failed 0/1 because
  current master migrated this file to Vitest. Corrected to
  `npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=2 test/docs-fleet-verbs.test.ts`: 30/0.
- `npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=2 test/mcp-output-efficiency.test.ts test/m129.agent-surface.test.ts test/m169.mcp-fleet-surface.test.ts test/m31.native-tools.test.ts test/verse-api-mount-310.test.ts test/authority-codeowners-310b.test.ts test/authority-tier1-closure-310b.test.ts test/tier1-apps-boundary.test.ts test/web-read-session-revocations.test.ts test/channel-envelope.test.ts`:
  initial 102 passed/31 failed. CODEOWNERS, MCP surface suites, channel envelope
  and read-session revocation passed. Failures included stale inventories,
  schema snapshots, authority growth, existing apps boundary, one module-load
  timeout and 23 loopback EPERM failures.
- `npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=2 test/mcp-output-efficiency.test.ts --update`:
  two snapshots updated, 2 passed/1 failed on preexisting intent allocation
  drift; inventory/budget accounting subsequently corrected.
- `npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=2 test/mcp-output-efficiency.test.ts test/fleet-forum-sim.test.ts test/verse-api-mount-310.test.ts`:
  9 passed/24 failed: simulation 2/0; mount table and handlers passed, with
  23 remaining real-server tests denied loopback access. One exact tool-order
  expectation was then corrected.
- `npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=1 test/mcp-output-efficiency.test.ts`:
  final 3 passed/0 failed, including both snapshots and all independent budgets.
- `npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=2 test/fleet-mission.test.ts`: final 11/0.
- `npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=2 test/leader-reply-clean-original-238s.test.ts test/leader-status-reply.test.ts`:
  initial 11 passed/3 failed on the obsolete freshness fixture described above.
- `npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=2 test/leader-reply-clean-original-238s.test.ts test/leader-status-reply.test.ts test/leader-rollup-freshness-147.test.ts`:
  final 26 passed/0 failed; all fresh/stale evidence safeguards remain intact.
- Explicit ESLint on every changed JS/TS/TSX file, using
  `node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --no-warn-ignored -- <git diff HEAD --name-only JS/TS/TSX paths>`:
  passed, no diagnostics. Command selection used execFileSync/spawnSync, not
  shell interpolation of paths.
- `git diff --check`: passed. `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U`: empty.

## Remaining gates

AGENTS.md explicitly says "Snapshot regeneration remains Mason-only."
Accordingly neither `npm run authority:regen` nor an update-mode snapshot test
was run. New Tier-1 roots: none. Closure growth requiring review:

- src/core/fleet/forum-channel-ingest.ts
- src/core/fleet/forum/bridge.ts
- src/core/fleet/forum/canon.ts
- src/core/fleet/forum/keys.ts
- src/core/fleet/forum/mcp.ts
- src/core/fleet/forum/policy.ts
- src/core/fleet/forum/service.ts
- src/core/fleet/forum/store.ts
- src/core/fleet/forum/types.ts
- src/core/fleet/forum/view.ts
- src/core/verse/forum-api.ts

The apps-boundary test separately reports the existing chain
`outcomes-api.reissue.test.ts -> outcomes-api.ts -> verse-api.ts ->
fleet-apps-recovery-api.ts -> apps-recovery-invocations.ts` and related history
and verdict modules. This patch adds no edge on that chain. Its two failing
assertions remain intact. Real-server mount tests need a host that permits
loopback connections. No security gate, workflow permission, release setting,
workflow secret reference, provider auth configuration or live fleet installation was changed.

Acceptance is unmet: the remote PR remains open/conflicting with failed Merge
Gate, and was not enqueued. A future authorized publication must update the
existing PR branch through publish.sh, then use the repository's normal merge
queue after required checks pass. No admin override was used.

## Final totals

Typecheck and all changed-file lint pass. Full lint rerun was stopped after
ten minutes without diagnostics (exit 130); full-lint success is not certified.

Latest per-file test results (not a full-suite certification): 240 passed,
26 failed, 0 skipped across 29 selected modules. The remaining failures are
23 host-denied loopback tests, 1 protected closure assertion and 2 existing
apps-boundary assertions. Corrected failures from earlier runs are listed
above and are not counted twice here.

Candidate diff versus unchanged HEAD: 45 files, +1809/-38, net +1771 LOC,
excluding this report. The inherited PNG is binary and has no LOC count.
The original PR was 71 files, +4156/-22. All candidate changes are uncommitted and unstaged.

* **New Features**
  * Added a Fleet forum for reading and posting messages, tracking commitments, sharing standups, and optionally mirroring posts to Telegram or Discord.
  * Added forum access in the mobile app and a `phm forum` command family.
  * Expanded Fleet Mission with activity, plan log, merge timeline, forum details, and merge-cost and queue status.
  * Added `phm app state` with JSON output and live Mission updates.
* **Documentation**
  * Added guides for Fleet Mission and the forum, with links in the documentation index.
